title: Valuation Date of a Deferred Fixed Annuities Death Benefit: Whole Life Certificates and Late Claims
content:
The valuation date of the death benefit on an Ashgrove Deferred Fixed Annuities contract can be set by a certificate already received on the owner's Ashgrove Whole Life Insurance claim, or by a long delay between the death and the annuity claim.

## Rule

The valuation date of the death benefit is:

1. where a certified death certificate for the owner was received on an Ashgrove Whole Life Insurance death claim **before** this contract's death claim was received — the date that certificate was received;
2. where no certified death certificate for the owner has been received on any Ashgrove Whole Life Insurance death claim, and this contract's death claim was received **more than 365 days** after the date of death — the date of death plus 365 days;
3. otherwise — the date this contract's death claim was received.

The valuation interest period runs to the valuation date.

## Records read

- The owner's Ashgrove Whole Life Insurance death claim: whether a certified death certificate was received, and the date received.
- This contract's death claim: the date it was received and the owner's date of death.

## Worked cases (hypothetical, owner died 3 January 2025)

| Whole Life Insurance death claim | Annuity death claim received | Valuation date |
|---|---|---|
| Certificate received 20 January 2025 | 10 March 2025 | 20 January 2025 |
| None | 15 February 2026 (408 days after the death) | 3 January 2026 (the date of death plus 365 days) |
| None | 3 January 2026 (exactly 365 days after) | 3 January 2026 — not more than 365 days, so the claim date |
| None | 10 March 2025 | 10 March 2025 |
